metadata.description: CEH Claude Code plugins for the full software development lifecycle.

plugins.name: ceh-core
plugins.description: CEH core: standards that hold however Claude Code is used — usage-limit handoff and context economy via delegated bulk reads.

plugins.name: ceh-coding-agent
plugins.description: CEH coding-agent standards: the behavior contract and five-step workflow, write-less-code minimalism, retroactive refactoring, and whole-repo explanation.

plugins.name: ceh-git-workflow
plugins.description: CEH Git workflow: branching, commits, pull requests from open to merge (with definition-of-done gate), changelog entries, releases including hotfixes, and code review. Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: ceh-architecture
plugins.description: CEH architecture: stack-agnostic design moments — living architecture documentation (Mermaid diagrams + a Key Decisions log) and domain modeling.

plugins.name: ceh-seo
plugins.description: CEH SEO: discoverability standards for anything exposed to the internet — technical SEO/GEO for public web pages (meta tags, structured data, sitemap, rendering strategy), authoring the llms.txt agent index, and findability of public-facing text (README first screen, package descriptions and keywords, repo topics, landing copy).

plugins.name: ceh-blog
plugins.description: CEH blog: turn a half-formed idea into a compelling, publishable blog post in a personal, series-first voice via structured interview; repurpose finished posts for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TL;DR, and newsletters.
